style: 既存の彩色人物画に合わせた腰までの透過画像。肖像・立ち絵で同じ画像を共用。性別・外見・年代・服装は今回の美術設定で、原文の既定情報ではない。

files.prompt_en: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an isolated transparent dialogue character cutout for a Japanese dungeon RPG, delivered as a PNG with genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the person. Single adult character, centered waist-up composition, complete hair silhouette and both hands visible, lower edge below the belt, generous empty transparent margins at both sides and above. Vertical portrait canvas, 1024 by 1536 pixels. Detailed painted game illustration with tactile linen and worn leather, clean readable facial features, muted earth colors, soft warm light from upper left, eye-level three-quarter view. The whole surrounding area is fully empty transparency, including the space beside the shoulders and head. Plain unlettered clothing surfaces. Subject: Zed, a mercenary who escorts travelers home, an adult man in his early forties with a broad strong build, deep brown skin, a square face, dark brown eyes, closely cropped black hair and a short carefully trimmed black beard. His expression is sober and thoughtful, his brows gently drawn together and his lips relaxed as he explains a difficult truth to his apprentice. He wears a weathered grey-blue quilted protective coat with a simple leather fastening over a dark linen shirt, a muted ochre scarf tucked close to his collar, plain leather wrist guards and a wide brown belt. Both empty hands are fully visible near the waist, one held slightly open in a restrained explanatory gesture while the other rests loosely alongside the belt. His posture is steady and practical. His square bearded face, broad silhouette, grey-blue quilted coat and ochre scarf define his identity.
files.prompt_ja: 用途：日本語ダンジョンRPGの透過会話人物画。人物以外の全域に透明なアルファを持つPNG。成人1人を中央に配置し、髪の輪郭と両手が入り、帯の下で自然に終わる腰までの構図。左右と頭上に十分な透過余白を取る。1024×1536の縦画面。麻と使い込まれた革の質感を備えた緻密な彩色ゲーム人物画。顔の特徴が読み取りやすく、落ち着いた土色、左上からの柔らかい暖色光、目の高さからの斜め正面。肩や頭の周囲も完全な透過。衣服は文字のない無地。人物はゼド、旅人の帰還を護衛する傭兵。40代前半の成人男性。幅広で力強い体格、濃い褐色の肌、四角い顔、濃い茶色の目、短く刈った黒髪、丁寧に整えた短い黒いひげ。見習いへ話しにくい事実を説明するように、眉をわずかに寄せ、唇の力を抜いた、落ち着いて思案する表情。濃色の麻のシャツの上に、簡素な革の留め具がついた使い込まれた灰青色のキルティングの防護上着を着る。くすんだ黄土色の襟巻きを襟元へ収め、無地の革の手首当てと幅広の茶色のベルトを着用する。空の両手全体を腰の近くに見せ、片手は控えめに説明するように少し開き、もう片方はベルトの横へ自然に添える。安定した実務的な姿勢。ひげのある四角い顔、幅広の輪郭、灰青色のキルティングの上着と黄土色の襟巻きで人物を明確にする。
